event_kinds.description: Which transitions send a message. A PagerDuty destination opens an incident when the alert fires and resolves it when the alert resolves, whatever this lists. Defaults to every kind.

pagerduty_region.description:
PagerDuty service region of the account. Used when type=pagerduty.

* `us` - us
* `eu` - eu

pagerduty_routing_key.description: Integration key of a PagerDuty Events API v2 integration. Required when type=pagerduty.

pagerduty_severity.description:
Severity PagerDuty records on the incident. Used when type=pagerduty.

* `critical` - critical
* `error` - error
* `warning` - warning
* `info` - info

slack_channel_id.description: Slack channel ID. Required when type=slack.

slack_workspace_id.description: Integration ID for the Slack workspace. Required when type=slack.

type.description:
Notification destination type.

* `slack` - slack
* `webhook` - webhook
* `teams` - teams
* `discord` - discord
* `pagerduty` - pagerduty

webhook_url.description: HTTPS endpoint to post to. Required for webhook, teams and discord.
